final_message:
The change likely fails the independent checks.

The storefront list filters boxes only after pagination, so hidden boxes still consume page slots and the response metadata may still report them in totals. A page containing only hidden boxes can appear empty even when visible boxes exist on later pages. Filtering must occur in the query/service layer before pagination.

The hidden-by-code endpoint handling appears correct, assuming the existing exception resolver maps `ResourceNotFoundException` to 404.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 93
